paragraphs: Federal Signal Corporation, founded in 1901, was reincorporated as a Delaware corporation in 1969. The Company designs, manufactures, and supplies a suite of products and integrated solutions for municipal, governmental, industrial, and commercial customers. The Company's portfolio of products that it manufactures includes (i) vehicles and equipment for maintenance and infrastructure end-markets, including sewer cleaners, industrial vacuum loaders, vacuum- and hydro-excavation trucks (collectively, "safe-digging trucks"), street sweepers, waterblasting equipment, refuse collection vehicles, road-marking and line-removal equipment, dump truck bodies, trailers, metal extraction support equipment, and multi-purpose maintenance vehicles, and (ii) public safety equipment, such as vehicle lightbars and sirens, industrial signaling equipment, public warning systems, and general alarm/public address systems. In addition, the Company engages in the sale of parts, service and repair, equipment rentals, and training as part of a comprehensive aftermarket offering to its customers. The Company operates 26 principal manufacturing facilities in five countries and provides products and integrated solutions to customers in all regions of the world.

Products manufactured and supplied, and services rendered, by the Company are divided into two reportable segments: the Environmental Solutions Group and the Safety and Security Systems Group. The individual operating businesses are organized as such because they share certain characteristics, including technology, marketing, distribution, and product application, which create long-term synergies. Corporate contains those items that are not included in the Company's reportable segments.

Financial information concerning the Company's two reportable segments for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2025, is included in Note 17 – Segment Information in Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data, and is incorporated herein by reference.

In 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of substantially all the assets and operations of Waterblasting, LLC, owner of Hog Technologies, and Waterblasting Eurasia, s.r.o. (collectively, "Hog"), the acquisition of all of the outstanding equity interests of Scranton Manufacturing Company LLC d/b/a New Way Trucks ("New Way"), and the acquisition of certain assets and operations of Kinloch Equipment & Supply, Inc. ("Kinloch"). Each of these acquisitions is included in the Environmental Solutions reportable segment. See Note 2 - Acquisitions in Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data, for additional information.

The Company's Environmental Solutions Group is a leading manufacturer and supplier of a full range of street sweepers, sewer cleaners, industrial vacuum loaders, safe-digging trucks, high-performance waterblasting equipment, road-marking and line-removal equipment, refuse collection vehicles, dump truck bodies, trailers, metal extraction support equipment, and multi-purpose maintenance vehicles. The Environmental Solutions Group manufactures vehicles and equipment in the U.S. and Canada that are sold under the Elgin®, Vactor®, Guzzler®, TRUVAC®, WestechTM, Jetstream®, Blasters, Mark Rite Lines, Hog, New Way®, Trackless, Ox Bodies®, Crysteel®, J-Craft®, Duraclass®, Rugby®, Travis®, OSW, NTE, WTB, Ground Force, TowHaul®, Bucks®, and Switch-N-Go® brand names. The Environmental Solutions Group's product offerings also include certain products manufactured by other companies, such as refuse collection vehicles. Products are sold to both municipal and industrial customers either through a dealer network or direct sales to service customers generally depending on the type and geographic location of the customer. In addition to vehicle and equipment sales, the Environmental Solutions Group also engages in the sale of parts, service and repair, equipment rentals, and training as part of a comprehensive aftermarket offering to its current and potential customers through its service centers, which are located across North America.

Under the Elgin brand name, the Company sells a leading U.S. brand of street sweepers that are primarily designed for large-scale cleaning of curbed streets, parking lots, and other paved surfaces and that utilize mechanical sweeping, vacuum, and recirculating air technology. Vactor is a leading manufacturer of equipment solutions for cleaning and maintaining sewers and catch basins. Under the TRUVAC brand name, the Company manufactures a range of premium vacuum- and hydro-excavation trucks designed to satisfy the safe-digging requirements of businesses or organizations that locate and verify underground utility lines and pipes. Guzzler is a leader in industrial vacuum loaders used to manage industrial waste or recover and recycle valuable raw materials. Westech is a manufacturer of high-quality, rugged vacuum-excavation trucks. Jetstream manufactures high-pressure waterblasting equipment and accessories for commercial and industrial cleaning and maintenance operations. New Way is a leading U.S.-based designer and manufacturer of refuse collection vehicles. Blasters is a leading U.S. manufacturer of truck-mounted waterblasting equipment. Mark Rite Lines Equipment Company, Inc. ("MRL") and Hog are U.S. manufacturers of truck-mounted and ride-on road-marking and line-removal equipment. Trackless is a leading Canadian manufacturer of off-road, multi-purpose maintenance vehicles and attachments. Ground Force and TowHaul are leading manufacturers of specialty

vehicles that support the extraction of metals. Truck Bodies & Equipment International ("TBEI") manufactures and sells dump truck bodies and trailers under the Ox Bodies, Crysteel, J-Craft, Duraclass, Rugby, Travis, OSW, NTE, and WTB brand names, as well as a range of interchangeable truck body systems and waste-hauling products under the Bucks and Switch-N-Go brand names.

The Company's Safety and Security Systems Group is a leading manufacturer and supplier of comprehensive systems and products that law enforcement, fire rescue, emergency medical services, campuses, military facilities, and industrial sites use to protect people and property. Offerings include systems for community alerting, emergency vehicles, first responder interoperable communications, and industrial communications. Specific products include public safety equipment, such as vehicle lightbars and sirens, industrial signaling equipment, public warning systems, and general alarm/public address systems. Products are sold under the Federal SignalTM, Federal Signal VAMA®, and Victor® brand names. The Safety and Security Systems Group operates manufacturing facilities in the U.S., Spain, the United Kingdom ("U.K."), and South Africa.

Depending primarily on the type and geographic location of the end-customer, the Environmental Solutions Group uses either a dealer network or direct sales to serve customers. The dealer network serves both municipal and industrial end-markets. Within municipal markets, the majority of the Company's dealers operate exclusively in their assigned territory. In conjunction with selling vehicles to end-customers, dealer representatives demonstrate vehicle functionality and capability and provide vehicle service. In addition to selling products manufactured by the Company, certain of our businesses distribute and re-sell products manufactured by other companies. The Company believes its regional, national, and global dealer networks for vehicles is a distinguishing factor from its competitors. The Company has an ownership interest in certain dealers.

The Environmental Solutions Group's direct sales channel concentrates primarily on the industrial, utility, and construction market segments. To support current and potential customers in these market segments, the Environmental Solutions Group also engages in the sale of parts, service and repair, equipment rentals, and training through its service centers located across North America.

The Safety and Security Systems Group sells to industrial customers through wholesalers and distributors who are supported by Company sales personnel or independent manufacturer representatives. Products are also sold to municipal and governmental customers through active independent distributors as well as through original equipment manufacturers and the direct sales force. The Company sells comprehensive integrated warning and interoperable communications through a combination of the direct sales force and independent distributors. International sales are made through independent foreign distributors or on a direct basis.
No single customer accounted for 10% or more of the Company's net sales in any year within the three-year period ended December 31, 2025.

The Company's backlog totaled $1.04 billion at December 31, 2025, compared to $997 million at December 31, 2024. Backlogs vary by group due to the nature of the Company's products and the buying patterns of its customers. The Environmental Solutions Group typically experiences an average backlog of approximately two to eight months of shipments. The Safety and Security Systems Group typically experiences an average backlog of approximately two months of shipments. While customer demand has contributed to longer lead times for certain products, production of the Company's December 31, 2025 backlog is expected to be substantially completed during 2026.

The Company purchases a wide variety of raw materials from around the world for use in the manufacture of its products, although the majority of its purchases are currently from North American sources. To minimize risks relating to availability, price, and quality of key products and components, the Company is party to numerous strategic supplier arrangements. Although certain materials are obtained from either a single-source supplier or a limited number of suppliers, the Company has generally identified alternative sources to minimize the interruption of its business in the event of supply disruptions. However, a transition to a new supplier may cause the Company to incur supply disruptions and unanticipated costs.

paragraphs: We may occasionally make forward-looking statements and estimates such as forecasts and projections of our future performance or statements of our plans and objectives. These forward-looking statements may be contained in, but are not limited to, filings with the SEC, including this Form 10-K, press releases made by us, and oral statements made by our officers. Actual results could differ materially from those contained in such forward-looking statements. Important factors that could cause our actual results to differ from those contained in such forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, the risks described below.
Our financial results are subject to U.S. economic uncertainty and compliance with laws and regulations.

In 2025, we generated approximately 79% of our net sales in the U.S. Our ability to be profitable depends heavily on varying conditions in the U.S. governmental and municipal markets, as well as the overall U.S. economy. The industrial markets in which we compete are subject to considerable cyclicality and move in response to cycles in the overall business environment. Many of our customers are municipal government agencies; therefore, we are dependent on municipal government spending. Spending by our municipal customers can be affected by federal, state, and local political circumstances, budgetary constraints, changing priorities, actual or potential government shutdowns, and other factors. The U.S. presidential administration has enacted certain spending freezes and other changes to federal government processes, and there is continuing uncertainty regarding federal agency structure and future budget decisions and priorities. The U.S. government and municipalities depend heavily on tax revenues as a source of spending, and accordingly, there is a historical correlation that suggests a lag of one to two years between the condition of the U.S. economy and our sales to the U.S. government and municipalities. Therefore, downturns in the U.S. economy are likely to result in decreases in demand for our products. During previous economic downturns, we experienced decreases in sales and profitability, and we expect our business to remain subject to similar economic fluctuations in the future. In addition, the extent of any potential changes to policies, tax laws, and regulations, and how any such changes may impact the Company's financial results and operations, is currently uncertain. For example, the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development ("OECD") issued Pillar Two model rules introducing a new global minimum corporate tax of 15%, which became effective in certain countries in 2024. Because the U.S. has not adopted Pillar Two, on January 5, 2026, the OECD issued a non-retroactive "Side-by-Side" safe harbor package for U.S. companies with multinational operations to better align the regime with the U.S. tax system. While Pillar Two applies to our worldwide operations, we do not have material operations in jurisdictions with tax rates lower than the Pillar Two minimum and therefore have not experienced material increases in our global tax costs. We continue to monitor U.S. and global legislative action related to Pillar Two for potential impacts.

Government administrations and agencies, political figures, the investment community, employees, and other stakeholders have had an increased focus on sustainability issues and initiatives, including negative reactions to implementation of such initiatives. Changes in laws and regulations in response to such matters could require material efforts and costs by us, and our suppliers, to comply with such changes. The costs of compliance with the various laws, regulations, and policies applicable to us could be significant and penalties for non-compliance could significantly impact our business.

We have international operations that are subject to compliance with domestic and foreign laws and regulations and can be impacted by economic and political uncertainties and conflicts and foreign currency rate fluctuations.

Our business is subject to fluctuations in demand and changes in international economic, legal, and political conditions that are beyond our control. In 2025, approximately 21% of our net sales were to customers outside the U.S., and we expect a significant portion of our net sales to come from international sales in the foreseeable future. Operating in the international marketplace exposes us to a number of risks, including the need to comply with U.S. and foreign laws and regulations applicable to our foreign operations, such as the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, the United Kingdom ("U.K.") Bribery Act, and their counterparts in the other foreign jurisdictions in which we operate, restrictive domestic and international trade regulations, and changes in these laws, regulations, and policies by the U.S. and foreign governments. In addition, we may be exposed to risks and adverse economic effects associated with changes in tax laws, escalation of geopolitical conflicts, actual or threatened imposition of tariffs or trade barriers on our products or materials incorporated into our products, actual or threatened trade disputes, including so-called "trade wars," political and economic instability in the jurisdictions in which we operate, foreign accounts receivable collection risk, and local labor market conditions. Further, the U.S. presidential administration has implemented, and may continue to implement, significant tariffs on imported goods. In February 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court struck down certain of these tariffs, but it is possible the administration may seek to reinstate all or some of such tariffs under alternative legal theories or support. The resulting uncertainty regarding the struck-down tariffs and potential re-implementation may result in additional political and economic instability. The continued imposition of such tariffs may strain international trade relations or impact costs of raw materials.

paragraphs: The Company is a leading global manufacturer and supplier of (i) vehicles and equipment for maintenance and infrastructure end-markets, including sewer cleaners, industrial vacuum loaders, safe-digging trucks, street sweepers, waterblasting equipment, refuse collection vehicles, road-marking and line-removal equipment, dump truck bodies, trailers, metal extraction support equipment, and multi-purpose maintenance vehicles, and (ii) public safety equipment, such as vehicle lightbars and sirens, industrial signaling equipment, public warning systems, and general alarm/public address systems. Product offerings also include certain products manufactured by other companies, such as third-party refuse and recycling collection vehicles. In addition, we engage in the sale of parts, service and repair, equipment rentals, and training as part of a comprehensive aftermarket offering to our customer base. We operate 26 manufacturing facilities in five countries and provide products and integrated solutions to municipal, governmental, industrial, and commercial customers in all regions of the world.

As described in Note 17 – Segment Information in Item 8, Financial Statements and Supplementary Data, in this Form 10-K the Company's business units are organized in two reportable segments: the Environmental Solutions Group and the Safety and Security Systems Group.

Federal Signal Corporation, 於1901年成立，於1969年重組為德拉瓦州公司。本公司設計、製造與供應一系列產品與整合解決方案，用以服務市府、政府、工業與商業客戶。本公司製造的產品組合包括(i)用於維護與基礎建設終端市場的車輛與設備，包括下水道清潔機、工業吸塵 loaders、吸塵與水力開挖貨車（合稱為"安全挖掘貨車"）、街道清潔機、水壓清洗設備、垃圾收集車、道路標線與線條清除設備、傾卸貨車車身、拖車、金屬開採支援設備與多用途維護車輛，以及(ii)公共安全設備，例如車輛警示燈與警報器、工業信號設備、公共警告系統與一般警報/公共廣播系統。此外，本公司亦從事零件銷售、服務與維修、設備租賃與培訓，作為對客戶的全面後市場服務。本公司在五個國家擁有26個主要製造廠，並向全球各區域的客戶提供產品與整合解決方案。
本公司製造與供應的產品與服務，分為兩個應報告分部：環境解決方案組與安全與安全系統組。個別營運業務如此組織，是因為它們共享某些特徵，包括技術、行銷、分銷與產品應用，這些特徵創造長期的協同效益。公司則包含那些未包含在本公司應報告分部的項目。
關於本公司兩個應報告分部在2025年12月31日結止期間的三個會計年度的財務資訊，請參閱第17項－分部資訊，於第8項財務報表與補充資料中，並 hereby 予以引用。

2025年，本公司完成對Waterblasting, LLC（為Hog Technologies所有者）與Waterblasting Eurasia, s.r.o.（合稱為"Hog"） substantially 所有資產與營運的收購，以及對Scranton Manufacturing Company LLC d/b/a New Way Trucks（"New Way"）所有現有權益的收購，以及對Kinloch Equipment & Supply, Inc.（"Kinloch"）部分資產與營運的收購。這些收購均包含在環境解決方案應報告分部。有關更多資訊，請參閱第2項－收購，於第8項財務報表與補充資料中。

本公司環境解決方案組為街道清潔機、下水道清潔機、工業吸塵 loaders、安全挖掘貨車、高性能水壓清洗設備、道路標線與線條清除設備、垃圾收集車、傾卸貨車車身、拖車、金屬開採支援設備與多用途維護車輛的領導製造與供應商。環境解決方案組在美國與加拿大製造車輛與設備，並以Elgin®、Vactor®、Guzzler®、TRUVAC®、WestechTM、Jetstream®、Blasters、Mark Rite Lines、Hog、New Way®、Trackless、Ox Bodies®、Crysteel®、J-Craft®、Duraclass®、Rugby®、Travis®、OSW、NTE、WTB、Ground Force、TowHaul®、Bucks®與Switch-N-Go®品牌銷售。環境解決方案組的產品組合亦包括由其他公司製造的某些產品，例如垃圾收集車。產品透過經銷網路或直接銷售至服務客戶，視客戶類型與地理區域而定。除了車輛與設備銷售，環境解決方案組亦從事零件銷售、服務與維修、設備租賃與培訓，作為對現有與潛在客戶的全面後市場服務，透過其服務中心，位於北美各地。

在Elgin品牌名稱下，本公司銷售美國領先的街道清潔機，主要設計用於大規模清潔路肩、停車場與其他鋪裝表面，並採用機械清潔、吸塵與循環空氣技術。Vactor為清潔與維護下水道與集水井的設備解決方案的領導製造商。在TRUVAC品牌名稱下，本公司製造一系列高級吸塵與水力開挖貨車，用以滿足企業或組織定位與驗證地下電力線與管道的安全挖掘需求。Guzzler為工業吸塵 loaders 的領導製造商，用以管理工業廢料或回收與再利用貴重原材料。Westech為高品質、堅固的吸塵開挖貨車製造商。Jetstream製造高壓水壓清洗設備與配件，用於商業與工業清潔與維護作業。New Way為美國領先的垃圾收集車設計與製造商。Blasters為美國領先的卡車載水壓清洗設備製造商。Mark Rite Lines Equipment Company, Inc.（"MRL"）與Hog為美國製造卡車載與騎行式道路標線與線條清除設備的製造商。Trackless為加拿大領先的非鋪裝、多用途維護車輛與配件製造商。Ground Force與TowHaul為專門製造支援金屬開採的車輛的領導製造商。
Truck Bodies & Equipment International（"TBEI"）製造與銷售傾卸貨車車身與拖車，品牌為Ox Bodies、Crysteel、J-Craft、Duraclass、Rugby、Travis、OSW、NTE與WTB，以及一系列可交換的車身系統與廢料運輸產品，品牌為Bucks與Switch-N-Go。

本公司安全與安全系統組為法 enforcement、消防救災、緊急醫療服務、校園、軍事設施與工業場地用以保護人與財產的綜合系統與產品的領導製造與供應商。產品包括社區警報系統、緊急車輛、第一 responders 互通通訊系統與工業通訊系統。具體產品包括公共安全設備，例如車輛警示燈與警報器、工業信號設備、公共警告系統與一般警報/公共廣播系統。產品以Federal SignalTM、Federal Signal VAMA®與Victor®品牌銷售。安全與安全系統組在美國、西班牙、英國（"U.K."）與南非設有製造廠。

依客戶類型及地理區域不同，環境解決方案部門使用經銷網路或直接銷售方式來服務客戶。經銷網路服務於市府及工業端市場。在市府市場中，本公司絕大多數經銷商僅在其指定區域內營運。在向終端客戶銷售車輛時，經銷代表會展示車輛的功能與性能，並提供車輛服務。此外，某些業務除了銷售本公司製造的產品外，也分銷及重新銷售其他公司製造的產品。本公司認為其在車輛領域的區域性、國家性及全球性經銷網路是與競爭對手不同的特色。本公司對某些經銷商擁有權益。
環境解決方案部門的直接銷售通路主要集中在工業、電力與建設市場。為支持這些市場的現有及潛在客戶，環境解決方案部門也透過其位於北美各地的服務中心，銷售零件、服務與維修、設備租賃及培訓。
安全與保安系統部門透過經銷商與代理商銷售給工業客戶，這些經銷商與代理商受本公司銷售人員或獨立製造商代表支援。產品也透過活躍的獨立經銷商及原廠設備製造商與直接銷售團隊銷售給市府及政府客戶。本公司透過直接銷售團隊與獨立經銷商的組合，銷售完整的整合式警告系統與互通式通訊系統。國際銷售透過獨立的外國經銷商或直接銷售進行。
在截至2025年12月31日的三年期間內，沒有任何單一客戶佔本公司淨銷售額10%或以上。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司未完成訂單總計為10.4億美元，與2024年12月31日的9.97億美元相比。未完成訂單因產品性質及客戶購買新增而有所不同。環境解決方案部門通常會有約兩至八個月的出貨未完成訂單。安全與保安系統部門通常會有約兩個月的出貨未完成訂單。雖然客戶需求導致某些產品的交貨時間延長，但本公司2025年12月31日的未完成訂單預期將在2026年 substantially 完成生產。
本公司從世界各地購買大量原物料，用於製造其產品，雖然目前大多數採購來自北美地區。為降低關鍵產品與零組件的可得性、價格與品質風險，本公司與許多戰略供應商簽訂協議。雖然某些材料來自單一來源供應商或有限數量的供應商，但本公司通常已識別替代來源，以降低供應中斷對業務的影響。然而，轉換至新供應商可能會導致本公司遭遇供應中斷及預期外的成本。

paragraphs: 本公司為全球領先的製造與供應商，提供(i)用於維護與基礎建設終端市場的車輛與設備，包括下水道清潔機、工業吸塵機、安全挖掘卡車、街道清潔機、水壓清洗設備、垃圾收集車、道路標線與線條清除設備、傾卸卡車車身、拖車、金屬開採支撐設備，以及多用途維護車輛，以及(ii)公共安全設備，例如車輛警示燈與警報器、工業信號設備、公共警告系統，以及一般警報/公共廣播系統。產品組合亦包含由其他公司製造的產品，例如第三方垃圾與回收收集車輛。此外，本公司亦透過完整的後市場服務，提供零件銷售、服務與維修、設備租賃與培訓。本公司在全球五個國家擁有26個製造廠，為全球各地的市政府、政府機構、工業與商業客戶提供產品與整合解決方案。
如第8項財務資料與補充資料中「第17節－分部資訊」所述，於本Form 10-K中，本公司業務單位分為兩個應報告分部：環境解決方案羣組與安全與安全系統羣組。

headings: 資料安全與智慧財產權風險
paragraphs: 我們偶爾會做出預測性陳述與估計，例如對我們未來表現的預測或對我們計畫與目標的陳述。這些預測性陳述可能包含於，但不僅限於，向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的文件，包括本Form 10-K、我們發布的新聞稿，以及我們高層主管的口頭陳述。實際結果可能與這些預測性陳述所載內容有重大差異。可能導致我們實際結果與這些預測性陳述所載內容有重大差異的重要因素，包括但不僅限於下文所描述的風險。
我們的財務結果受到美國經濟不確定性與遵守法律與法規的影響。

2025年，我們約有79%的淨銷售額來自美國。我們能否獲利嚴重取決於美國政府與市級政府市場的條件變化，以及美國整體經濟狀況。我們所競爭的工業市場受到相當程度的週期性影響，並隨著整體商業環境的週期而變動。許多我們的客戶為市級政府機構；因此，我們的營運高度依賴市級政府支出。我們市級客戶的支出可能受到聯邦、州與地方政治情況、預算限制、改變的優先順序、實際或潛在的政府停擺，以及其他因素的影響。美國總統行政團隊已實施某些支出凍結及其他變更聯邦政府程序的措施，且有關聯邦機構結構與未來預算決策與優先順序的不確定性持續存在。美國政府與市級政府高度依賴稅收收入作為支出來源，因此，歷史資料顯示美國經濟狀況與我們對美國政府與市級政府的銷售之間存在一至兩年的延遲關係。因此，美國經濟衰退很可能導致我們產品的需求減少。在過去的經濟衰退期間，我們經歷了銷售與獲利的下降，我們預期未來業務仍將受到類似經濟波動的影響。此外，任何潛在的政策、稅法與法規變更的範圍，以及這些變更可能如何影響本公司財務結果與營運，目前仍不確定。例如，經濟合作與發展組織（"OECD"）發布了Pillar Two模型規則，引入了新的全球最低企業稅率15%，該規則在某些國家於2024年生效。由於美國尚未採納Pillar Two，因此在2026年1月5日，OECD發布了一個非追溯性的"Side-by-Side"安全港包裝，用以協助美國擁有國際業務的公司更好地與美國稅制對齊。雖然Pillar Two適用於我們的全球業務，但我們在稅率低於Pillar Two最低稅率的司法管轄區並無重大業務，因此我們尚未經歷全球稅務成本的重大增加。我們持續監測美國與全球立法行動與Pillar Two的相關內容，以評估潛在影響。
政府機構與部門、政治人物、投資社羣、員工及其他利害關係人對永續性議題與計畫的關注度提高，包括對實施這些計畫的負面反應。因應這些議題的法律與法規變更可能需要我們與供應商投入重大努力與成本以符合這些變更。我們需遵守的各種法律、法規與政策的成本可能相當顯著，違規處罰可能對我們的業務造成重大影響。
我們擁有國際業務，需遵守國內與外國法律與法規，並可能受到經濟與政治不確定性與衝突以及外幣匯率波動的影響。

我們的業務受到需求變動與國際經濟、法律與政治條件的影響，而這些條件超出我們的控制範疇。2025年，我們約有21%的淨銷售額來自美國以外的客戶，我們預期未來一段時間內將有相當大比例的淨銷售額來自國際銷售。在國際市場營運使我們面臨許多風險，包括需遵守適用於我們國際業務的美國與外國法律與法規，例如《反海外腐敗行為法》（Foreign Corrupt Practices Act）、英國（"U.K."）《貪污法》（Bribery Act）及其在其他我們營運的外國司法管轄區的對應法規、限制性的國內與國際貿易法規，以及美國與外國政府對這些法律、法規與政策的變更。此外，我們可能面臨與稅法變更、地緣政治衝突升級、我們產品或材料被課徵關稅或貿易壁壘的實際或威脅、實際或威脅的貿易爭議（包括所謂的"貿易戰"）、我們營運的司法管轄區的政治與經濟不穩定、外國應收帳款回收風險，以及當地勞動市場條件等風險。此外，美國總統行政團隊已實施，且可能持續實施，對進口商品的重大關稅。2026年2月，美國最高法院廢除了部分這些關稅，但美國政府可能依其他法律理論或支持而尋求恢復所有或部分這些關稅。有關被廢除關稅的不確定性以及可能重新實施的風險，可能導致額外的政治與經濟不穩定。持續實施這些關稅可能影響國際貿易關係或影響原材料的成本。
